title: UFC Undisputed 3 (UFC3MONS)
description: Native PC version of UFC Undisputed 3 for Windows and Linux, built with ReXGlue static recompilation and Vulkan. Our main focus is the community Reborn mod. Career and Exhibition are playable at 60 FPS, with walkouts and other scenes at 60 FPS. You need your own copy of the game.
